EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the psychology program at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for expressing interest in the Law and Psychology (PhD) program at Arizona State University. This program is designed to train a new generation of scholars in the field by taking a broad interdisciplinary approach that combines rigorous training in the law and psychology field with training in advanced research methodology and statistics, criminological theory, and contextual training in other subfields of psychology. The goal of the program is for our students to use this knowledge to tackle the many important but understudied areas where the legal system is in desperate need of empirical, psychological research. For more information feel free to click here. https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/majorinfo/ASU00/ASLPSYPHD/graduate/false?init=false&nopassive=true
Be sure to review our application checklist https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B44BICxe1BtdUS1zQnQ3YXRUVUE/view?usp=sharing for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format. Also, please take a moment to check out our new e-magazine http://links.asu.edu/xqkbm and see all the exciting work being done by our faculty and students.
It's important to find the right fit in graduate school. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can review the dates here, https://www.google.com/url?q=https%3A%2F%2Fnewcollege.asu.edu%2Fadmissions%2Fgraduate-student%23info-sessions&sa=D&sntz=1&usg=AFQjCNG3eyBeebKJl5UB8G4D0hhOqUBSSA then email me to RSVP for any date you plan to attend.
Kindest regards, Graduate Studies New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus nc.gradstudies@asu.edu
